title: Sales Report
summary: A concise report on sales performance, trends, and key metrics. It can include revenue, units sold, growth, and notable observations.
executed_sql_queries:
WITH order_totals AS (
  SELECT
    o.order_id,
    o.order_date,
    SUM(oi.total_amount) AS order_revenue
  FROM retail.orders o
  JOIN retail.order_items oi
    ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  GROUP BY o.order_id, o.order_date
)
SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date)::date AS month,
  SUM(order_revenue) AS monthly_revenue,
  COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS monthly_order_count
FROM order_totals
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  s.store_name,
  SUM(oi.total_amount) AS store_revenue,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS store_order_count,
  SUM(oi.quantity) AS store_units_sold,
  AVG(COALESCE(oi.discount_percent, 0)) AS average_discount
FROM retail.orders o
JOIN retail.order_items oi
  ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
 AND o.store_id = oi.store_id
JOIN retail.stores s
  ON o.store_id = s.store_id
WHERE s.store_name IN (
  'Zava Retail Seattle',
  'Zava Retail Bellevue',
  'Zava Retail Tacoma',
  'Zava Retail Spokane',
  'Zava Retail Everett',
  'Zava Retail Redmond',
  'Zava Retail Kirkland',
  'Zava Retail Online'
)
GROUP BY s.store_name
ORDER BY s.store_name;

WITH product_sales AS (
    SELECT
        p.category_id,
        c.category_name,
        p.type_id,
        pt.type_name,
        p.product_id,
        p.product_name,
        SUM(oi.total_amount) AS product_revenue,
        SUM(oi.quantity) AS product_units_sold,
        CASE WHEN SUM(oi.quantity) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE SUM(oi.total_amount) / SUM(oi.quantity) END AS average_selling_price
    FROM retail.order_items oi
    JOIN retail.products p
      ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN retail.categories c
      ON p.category_id = c.category_id
    JOIN retail.product_types pt
      ON p.type_id = pt.type_id
    GROUP BY
        p.category_id, c.category_name,
        p.type_id, pt.type_name,
        p.product_id, p.product_name
)
SELECT
    category_name,
    SUM(product_revenue) AS category_revenue,
    SUM(product_units_sold) AS category_units_sold,
    type_name AS product_type,
    SUM(product_revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY type_name) AS product_type_revenue,
    SUM(product_units_sold) OVER (PARTITION BY type_name) AS product_type_units_sold,
    product_name,
    product_revenue,
    product_units_sold,
    average_selling_price
FROM product_sales
ORDER BY category_name, product_type, product_revenue DESC, product_units_sold DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS inventory_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT store_id) AS stores_with_inventory, COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) AS products_with_inventory, SUM(stock_level) AS total_inventory_on_hand, SUM(CASE WHEN stock_level = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stockout_rows FROM retail.inventory;

SELECT s.store_name, s.is_online, SUM(i.stock_level) AS inventory_on_hand, COUNT(*) AS inventory_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT i.product_id) AS products_with_inventory, SUM(CASE WHEN i.stock_level = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stockout_indicator FROM retail.inventory i JOIN retail.stores s ON i.store_id = s.store_id GROUP BY s.store_name, s.is_online ORDER BY inventory_on_hand DESC;

SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, SUM(i.stock_level) AS inventory_on_hand, COUNT(*) AS inventory_rows, SUM(CASE WHEN i.stock_level = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stockout_indicator FROM retail.inventory i JOIN retail.products p ON i.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY inventory_on_hand DESC, p.product_name ASC LIMIT 20;
